notes: Clash Royale UI responsiveness and APK status detection fix: eliminated application freezing and 'Not Responding' states caused by synchronous ADB connect timeouts on closed emulator ports; added lightweight 35ms non-blocking TCP socket pre-probing; bundled and verified required AdbWinApi.dll alongside server ADB binaries; prevented multi-device ADB routing errors by explicitly addressing the active emulator serial with -s; made APK installation detection instantaneous via parallel async polling and automatic Reinstall/Uninstall button states; and prevented redundant concurrent polling loops in the desktop view.
